prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Tiny Sea War anime shipgirl naval game main-menu button UI component atlas, high quality raster art, transparent background.
Primary request: Design a cohesive stylish premium anime naval game button family that feels elegant, friendly and maritime, compatible with soft pastel anime character background illustrations. This is an isolated COMPONENT SHEET, not a screenshot or a full menu.
Style: delicately illustrated enamel plaques, refined shallow bevels, thin champagne-gold double pinstripe frames, subtly clipped corners with softly rounded transitions, dark petroleum teal enamel, restrained cyan edge light, tiny compass rose and wave/route engraving confined to the end caps. Clear broad plain center for runtime Chinese text. Tasteful anime game polish, crisp readable silhouette, no heavy industrial machinery. No actual political/military insignia.
Layout: exactly twelve separate horizontal rectangular buttons in a regular 3-column by 4-row grid, generous fully transparent gutters and outer margin. Every button same outer size, roughly 3.8:1 width/height. Front-on orthographic 2D. All elements fully within canvas. Transparent background outside each button.
Row 1: primary sortie button states, left default dark rich teal with a small gold compass rose at left and paired forward chevrons at right; middle hover same geometry with slightly brighter teal face and cyan inner highlight; right pressed same geometry darker inset enamel, lower relief, no outer glow.
Row 2: secondary navigation buttons, left default desaturated deep teal with small restrained route engraving at left; middle selected same geometry, warm gold inner line and small gold diamond selection indicator; right disabled same geometry, desaturated slate blue-gray with flat muted outlines and a tiny lock symbol on the right.
Row 3: light companion buttons for content pages, left normal sea-salt ivory and pale aqua enamel with deep teal frame accents; middle hover pale icy blue face with clear teal inner line; right pressed muted pale blue face with subtle inset edge.
Row 4: utility states in dark teal family, left keyboard focus with clearly separated fine outer focus contour and small corner brackets; middle warning with restrained coral inner border and small warning triangle at left; right quiet/back with low ornamentation and a small left-facing arrow at left.
Materials: subtle smooth glazed enamel and fine satin metal trim; minimal texture, restrained soft blue-gray shadow only close to each shape; no bloom clouds, no lens flare, no sparkles outside shapes.
Palette: petroleum teal #173F4D, ocean teal #286578, sea-salt white #F7FCFF, pale aqua #E8F7FB, muted champagne gold #D9BA79, restrained cyan #8DD9E8, coral #D9787D.
Constraints: No text, no letters, no numerals, no labels, no titles, no watermark. No character art. No scenery. No rectangular backing board. No checkerboard painted into background. Genuine transparent alpha background. Keep middle 65 percent of every button blank and quiet for program-rendered labels. Consistent dimensions and end-cap details across matching states. High-resolution, clean edges, all 12 pieces separated.
